river_name: Mulavagu stream (tributary of Godavari River) & Dharma Gundam (Pushkarni) / Gudicheruvu

ghats.name: Dharma Gundam Bathing Steps
ghats.description: Sacred temple tank with stone bathing steps, protective railings, and dedicated dress changing/bathing rooms for women.

significance: Legend has it that Raja Narendra (grandson of Parikshit) was cured of leprosy by taking a holy bath in Dharma Gundam, after which he discovered the Shiva Lingam in the tank bed and built the temple.
safety_rules: Follow safety guidelines while taking a holy bath. Ladies' changing rooms and bathing rooms are provided adjacent to the tank.
